description: Apple Finder on macOS via a use.computer remote sandbox. Finder is the macOS shell — preinstalled at /System/Library/CoreServices/Finder.app and always running. install_finder.sh verifies the bundle and seeds ~/Documents and ~/Downloads. setup_finder.sh writes Finder preferences via `defaults` (sidebar contents, view modes, file extension visibility, .DS_Store policy) to make the start state deterministic for verifiers. Tasks cover file organization, folder creation, tagging (xattr), and renaming — all verifiable via the filesystem (no Accessibility API required, so the TCC-over-SSH trap is avoided).
